structure.unit: General Provisions; Charters; Other Forms and Organization of Counties
Urban County Executive Form of Government

law.catch_line: No unincorporated area to be incorporated after adoption of urban county form of government
law.text: After the date of adoption of the urban county executive form of government, no unincorporated area within the limits of such county shall be incorporated as a separate town or city within the limits of such county, whether by judicial proceedings or otherwise.
